limitations: Identity is a synthetic local JWT-verifying HTTP provider, NOT GoTrue. No real signup, password recovery, refresh rotation, email delivery, MFA or external identity-provider acceptance.
Test-copy development CSP adds unsafe-eval required by Next webpack dev hydration, and connect-src adds only the exact synthetic loopback identity origin; production CSP is unchanged.
Local development Next runtime; production deployment, CDN, TLS and external providers remain unverified.
API key creation is not attested exactly once; unknown outcomes require review and revocation before retry.
Injected database transport outages return explicit 503; successful database responses always come from real PostgREST/PostgreSQL.
sanitization: No URLs with token/query values, cookie values, JWTs, API keys, form values, process argv/environment or kernel addresses retained. Form validity, focus and lengths only. Missing pressure data is not proof of no I/O contention.
